parameters.prompt: =Analyze this image in detail. Identify: 1) Main objects and their positions 2) Scene context 3) Colors and composition 4) Text visible 5) Actions/activities 6) Quality and technical aspects

parameters.content:
## Computer Vision Pipeline

**Capabilities:**
- Multi-provider analysis (OpenAI, Google, Clarifai)
- Object detection & localization
- Facial recognition & emotion detection
- OCR text extraction
- Color analysis
- Safe search filtering
- Consensus labeling

**Use Cases:**
- Content moderation
- Product catalog tagging
- Document digitization
- Accessibility (alt text generation)
- Quality control
- Security surveillance

**API Endpoint:**
POST /webhook/vision-upload

**Request Body:**
{
  "image_url": "https://...",
  "tasks": ["detect", "classify", "ocr"],
  "confidence_threshold": 0.7
}
